body: Credibility-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.65 (naive sector base rate 0.64) that: Happy Forgings FY27 consolidated revenue growth is >=17.0% (proxy for its late-teen volume guide). Probability set only by the pre-stated rule (research_notes/Promise tracker pilot/AUTO_COMPONENTS_peer_comparison.md section 5): p0 = 0.64 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'revenue_growth', n=28); SAC +3.6 pts x weight 0.259 (N=7) -> p = 0.65. Evidence: Q4FY26 call (22-May-2026): 'late-teen volume growth ... EBITDA margins broadly in line with FY26'; restated Aug-26 and Nov-26 ('well-positioned to meet our full-year volume growth guidance'). H1FY27 volume +24%, realisation +5%, revenue +30% (screener 950 cr vs 731). FY26 revenue 1,546 cr; needs H2 >= ~859 cr (+5% YoY). Revenue is a proxy: guidance is on volume. Resolution: YES if FY27 consolidated revenue from operations / FY26 - 1 >= 17.0% (NSE XBRL + screener, one decimal). Source: NSE XBRL + screener.in consolidated. Resolve by 2027-05-31; score with Brier vs the base rate, to test whether the credibility adjustment adds skill.

data.adjustment_rule: p0 = leave-one-out pooled STRICT delivery rate (specificity-weighted share 'delivered'; partly=0) of the other 4 peers in the promise's category (all-category peer rate if <8 peer promises in that category). p = clip(p0 + N/(N+20) x SAC/100, 0.05, 0.95), N = company's scored promises, SAC in points (credit basis: delivered 1, partly 0.5; categories with n<5, or with <2 peers having data, pooled). P(base) = p0.
data.base_rate_reasoning: Naive forecaster = sector delivery rate for 'revenue_growth' promises among the other auto-component peers (strict: delivered only, specificity-weighted; n=28). No company-specific information.
data.resolution_rule: YES if FY27 consolidated revenue from operations / FY26 - 1 >= 17.0% (NSE XBRL + screener, one decimal).
